Check combinations of quasi-identifiers (k-anonymity)

check_k_anonymity.Rd

Counts how many persons share each combination of the quasi-identifiers. Persons in a combination shared by fewer than min_count persons are at risk of re-identification. Dates are compared at date_unit granularity and numeric variables with many values in deciles; group them yourself if you need another granularity.

Usage

check_k_anonymity(x, quasi_ids = NULL, id = NULL, config = NULL, target = NULL)

Arguments

x

A data frame, or a table/matrix of counts.

quasi_ids

Quasi-identifiers. Defaults to config$quasi_ids.

id

Person identifier in microdata. Persons, not rows, are counted. Without id each row is one person.

config

A mimic_config(); NULL uses the defaults.

target

Label used in reports.

Value

A mimic_check. details contains totals only, never the rare combinations.

Details

The result also shows how many persons would be at risk if each quasi-identifier were dropped, which points to the variable to coarsen.

See also

Other checks: check_differencing(), check_dominance(), check_extremes(), check_group_disclosure(), check_keys(), check_min_count(), check_model(), check_suppression()

Examples

check_k_anonymity(fake_persons, c("birth_date", "sex", "settlement"),
                  id = "person_id")
#> ✖ k_anonymity (fake_persons): 2,000 persons (about 100 %) are in combinations of birth_date, sex, settlement shared by fewer than 5 persons.
#>                      variables combinations rare_combinations persons_at_risk
#>  birth_date + sex + settlement        1,782             1,782           2,000
#>             without birth_date           41                11              25
#>                    without sex        1,599             1,597           1,990
#>             without settlement        1,309             1,301           1,960
